oc.prev_b: It’s an independent design proposal, not your official website. The content is a starting point for your review.
oc.prev_nourl: I’ve put together an initial website concept for your business. If you’re interested, I can share a preview for your review.
oc.close: Would you be interested in taking a look? If it feels like a good fit, reply with what you need and your budget. We can provide a tailored quote before you commit to a build.
oc.optout: If this isn’t relevant, reply “no thanks” and I won’t follow up.
pdf.a_lim: A missing source URL is not proof of no website. Connection errors do not establish closure or permanent unavailability. Contact fields and ownership must be independently verified.
pdf.c_imp: This PDF is an export of your tracker, not an electronically signed agreement, invoice, payment receipt or independently verified contract. No additional terms are implied.
pdf.i_terms: Payment due as specified. This is a record; verify acceptance and bank receipt separately. Additional terms must be agreed explicitly.
pdf.p_terms: Draft only. Pricing, scope, taxes, payment terms, schedule and acceptance must be expressly agreed with the client. Linked contract records remain separate. No automatic sending, signing or payment collection.
nw.e_links: Links need a label and an http(s), mailto or tel URL (max 8).
nw.e_qr: Add the page URL to encode (?u=/c/…).
nw.e_qr_host: QR codes only encode this studio's own pages.
nw.e_qr_lib: QR generation is unavailable on this machine.
nw.e_goal: Goal must be a number from 0 to 100000.
nw.e_qual: Add a question with 2–8 options for choice questions.
nw.e_photo: Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP photo of the card.
nw.e_vision_provider: Card reading needs a local Ollama vision model — {p} cannot read photos here.
nw.e_vision_failed: The model could not read this photo ({d}). Type the details by hand instead.
nw.e_windows: Weekly windows need a weekday and a start before end (HH:MM).
nw.e_trap: That submission looked automated — please use the form.
nw.e_book_fields: Add your name and a valid e-mail.
nw.e_book_many: Too many booking attempts — please try again later.
nw.e_slot: That slot is no longer open — pick another.
nw.e_hook: Add an https URL and at least one event.
oc.f_body:
Hi {n} team,

It was great meeting you at {e}. I’m {w} from {a} — as promised, here is a quick follow-up with nothing attached and nothing to buy.

If a simple website would help customers reach you, reply with what you need and I’ll sketch a free one-page concept first. No call, no pressure.

Best,
{w}
nw.c_nfc_ok: Card link written to the tag.
nw.c_nfc_no: NFC writing is not supported in this browser — the QR code and contact file work everywhere.
nw.b_pick: Pick a time — {s} confirms every request by e-mail.
nw.b_none: No open slots in the next two weeks — please check back later.
nw.b_ok: Requested — check your e-mail for confirmation.
nw.w_p: Your floor kit: digital cards, QR codes, event capture, booking and CRM hooks.
nw.w_delq: Delete this? This cannot be undone.
nw.w_empty_cards: No cards yet — create your first digital card.
nw.w_empty_ev: No events yet — create one before the doors open.
nw.w_offline: You are offline — this capture is saved on this device and will sync.
nw.w_basis: Contact basis (kept in the mail log)
nw.w_rev_req: Revenue attribution needs the Pro plan.
nw.w_noai: AI reading is unavailable — type the details by hand.
nw.w_ai_note: AI suggestion — check against the photo before saving.
nw.w_empty_hooks: No webhooks yet — push new leads straight into your CRM.
nw.w_hook_sig: Each call is signed with X-Reachmark-Signature.
au.o_team_d: Manage leads, outreach and events from the studio workspace.
au.o_me_d: Track my project, invoices and reviews as a client.
au.o_invalid: That sign-in link expired. Please try again.
au.o_denied: The sign-in was cancelled at the provider.
au.o_error: The provider did not respond. Please try again.
au.o_noemail: Your provider account has no email address to sign in with.
au.e_oauth_off: This sign-in method is not available.
